title: This Single DVD Is Traveling Around the Country to Find a Sweet Indie Film Its Audience
summary: After struggling to break through on the festival circuit, Matthew James Thompson packed his debut feature, "Handle With Care," into a mysterious case that's been bringing strangers together ever since.

title: Married ‘All That She Wants’ Filmmakers Scarlett Bermingham and Andrew Rhymer on Making a Rom-Com About Trying to Get Pregnant
summary: The directing duo's development as artists and parents mirrored that of Annie Murphy and Cooper Raiff's characters.

title: Who’s Keeping Paramount Honest? A Guide to the Watchdogs Policing David Ellison’s $110 Billion Deal
summary: The proposed decree divides oversight between an internal studio monitor, an independent trustee, state attorneys general, and a board of journalists. Here’s what each can do — and where their power stops.

title: ‘The Love Hypothesis’ Breakout Star Rachel Marsh Plays the BFF Every Rom-Com Heroine Needs
summary: In the Ali Hazelwood adaptation, Marsh plays best friend to leading lady Lili Reinhart, but she's no second fiddle. As the rising comedian tells IndieWire, she knows this kind of role is rare, and she really knows how to make it her own.

title: Curry Barker to Receive IndieWire’s Inaugural Future of Filmmaking Award
summary: The "Obsession" writer/director will accept the award at IndieWire's Future of Filmmaking Summit on October 17 in Los Angeles.

title: ‘Never After Dark’ Review: A Japanese Medium Is Forced to Confront a Living Threat in This Clever Ghost Story
summary: “Shōgun” breakout Moeka Hoshi plays a haunted ronin ghostbuster in Dave Boyle's nifty and unnerving Hokkaido chiller.

title: John Cassavetes Practically Invented the American Independent Film, but Some of His Best Movies Were Made for Studios
summary: Half of the director's 12 features were financed and distributed by major studios, and some — like "Minnie and Moskowitz," screening next week at the New Beverly — are as uncompromising as his scrappiest indies.

title: Harvey Weinstein Sentenced to 15 Years in Prison in New York Retrial
summary: The former film mogul was convicted on a count of criminal sexual assault against Miriam Haley in June 2025.

title: Jean Smart Joins ‘The Family Stone’ Sequel in First Post-‘Hacks’ Role
summary: The Emmy winner joins Claire Danes, Rachel McAdams, Sarah Jessica Parker, Dermot Mulroney, Craig T. Nelson, and Luke Wilson all returning for the follow-up to the 2005 holiday comedy.

title: A New Physical Media Label Is Releasing Some of Our Favorite Recent Indies — with a New Lineup Every Lunar Cycle
summary: Exclusive: Video Visions will bring films like "Fuck My Son!," "Dead Lover," and "Hundreds of Beavers" to physical media enthusiasts each month, with specific drops remaining secret until the moon changes.

title: ‘You Can See Everything’ Trailer: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Elizabeth Holmes Doc Is Going to Get Under Your Skin
summary: It takes a certain kind of person to let Nathan Fielder into your home in the days leading up to your extended incarceration in federal prison.

title: ‘Brothers’ Review: Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson Can’t Detect Any Truth in Apple’s Limp Meta Comedy
summary: Based on a "true rumor" started by Kay "MaMac" McConaughey, the family sitcom asks if the famous pals are actually biological brothers. But their vanity project is less about what separates "bro" from "brother" than what separates reality from scripted-reality.
